purpose: First production-quality interactive web experience for the completed Istanbul Urban Mobility Intelligence framework. Frontend/product implementation only -- no new analysis, no modified frozen output.

stack.basemap: CARTO Dark Matter (free, no API key; attribution shown via MapLibre attribution control)

frozen_data_contract: analysis/framework_synthesis/ (Phase 12 output) -- read-only. See docs/data_contract.md for the full field-level mapping.

frontend_preprocessing_performed.upstream_bug_found_and_fixed: cycling_required_categories_accessible_15min was never joined into the Phase 11 synthesis table; Phase 12 substituted the wrong (all-8-category) count under the name required_categories_cycle_15. Fixed in src/citywide/phase11_synthesis.py; full Phase 11->12->frontend chain re-run and re-verified (see docs/data_contract.md, qa/visual_qa.md).

map_interactions_implemented: click to select + open Grid Intelligence Card
district_exploration: Alphabetical district selector on every map page; selecting fits the map to that district's cells (no ranking).
case_study_interaction: CaseStudyNavigator on /overview; each of the 9 frozen Phase 12 case studies navigates to its relevant page with the actual cell pre-selected.
claim_registry_integration: lib/data.ts getClaim(claimId) is the sole path for headline analytical wording; used by KpiCard and ShareableInsightCard.
o3_sustainability_integration: Dark forest palette + Outfit typography applied product-wide via app/globals.css tokens; O3BrandMark + footer/landing copy establish O3 as publisher, not primary brand; editorial InsightCard highlight-panel variant used for the 'why this matters' framing on /overview.
shareable_insight_component: components/ShareableInsightCard.tsx; one working example (claim C02, 4:5 aspect) rendered on /overview.
responsive_behavior: Desktop: map + side Grid Intelligence Card. Mobile (<768px): map + fixed-position bottom-sheet Grid Intelligence Card, compact hamburger nav. Verified at 1440px and 390px via live browser screenshots.
accessibility: Keyboard focus rings (#B2F093, :focus-visible), aria-labels on the map/nav/close controls, semantic legend text (not color-only), select elements for filters (native keyboard support).
visual_qa: frontend/qa/visual_qa.md -- live Playwright screenshots at 1440px and 390px; 2 real bugs found and fixed during this pass (see file for full account).
performance_qa: frontend/qa/performance_qa.json -- payload sizes, build output, documented as local/loopback measurements only.
known_limitations: grid_map.geojson (~22.6MB) and grid_attributes.json (~27MB) are bulk-fetched client-side; acceptable for local MVP, a per-grid API route is the natural next step before wide deployment.

npm audit flags Next.js 14.2.35 production-server-side advisories (Server Actions, Image Optimization API, custom-server SSRF/RCE) -- irrelevant to a local dev/build MVP, must be addressed before any real deployment.
No dedicated 1280px screenshot pass (1440px layout is representative above the md: 768px breakpoint).

Fixed-guideway-specific cycling-gain boolean layer not separately joined into the map payload (Phase 11's transit_gap_type already keeps General vs Fixed-Guideway analytically distinct); noted as a natural follow-up increment.

The Playwright browser session used for QA was shared with other automated activity on this machine mid-session; all reported screenshots were re-verified against their expected URL before being trusted.
local_run_instructions: cd frontend && npm install && npm run dev (or npm run build && npm run start for production mode). Regenerate data first with npm run prepare-data if analysis/ has changed.

verified_build_and_run.npm_run_build: Compiled successfully, TypeScript type-checked with no errors, 9 pages generated.
verified_build_and_run.npm_run_dev: Confirmed serving on http://localhost:3001 (port 3000 was occupied by an unrelated process on this machine); all 9 pages and all data endpoints return HTTP 200; live-rendered and interacted with via Playwright.

stop_condition_respected: No public deployment, no domain purchase, no production analytics, no user accounts, no database, no new analytical model or conclusion, no automated social posting. Deployment is a separate future phase.
